backend/main.mo: Main actor defining user profiles, production records, dispatch records, daily production reports, and work-in-hand data with CRUD operations and admin-only access control using MixinAuthorization.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that upgrades actor state from OldActor to NewActor by adding dailyProductionReports map and nextReportId counter while preserving existing data.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three completed features for daily production report management: form page, table view with filtering/sorting, and navigation menu integration.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Truncated text file containing summaries of frontend components including App.tsx, Layout.tsx, various page components, forms, tables, and React Query hooks for backend integration.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes defining colors for UI elements like background, foreground, primary, secondary, borders, and charts.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React application with viewport meta tag and root div mounting point.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for dashboard, production entry/history, dispatch tracking, work-in-hand, and daily production reports, all wrapped with AuthGuard and Layout.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: Component displaying access restriction message with login button for unauthenticated or non-admin users attempting to access protected routes.
frontend/src/components/AuthGuard.tsx: Authentication guard component that checks login status and admin role, displays loading state during initialization, shows profile setup modal for new users, and renders AccessDeniedScreen for unauthorized access.
frontend/src/components/DailyProductionR: Filter component for daily production reports with date range and operation name filters. Includes predefined list of 17 default operations and provides apply/clear functionality.

Form component for creating and editing daily production reports with fields for date, operation, production metrics (today, total, dispatched, in-hand). Handles validation and uses custom hooks for create/update mutations.
Sortable table component displaying daily production reports with edit/delete actions. Supports sorting by date, operation, and numeric fields with ascending/descending order.
Reusable date range filter component with start/end date inputs and apply/clear buttons. Enforces logical date constraints (start before end).
frontend/src/components/DispatchEntryFor: Form for recording dispatch entries with fields for date, container type, quantity, destination, and tracking reference. Validates inputs and uses mutation hook to add records.
frontend/src/components/DispatchRecordsT: Sortable table displaying dispatch records with columns for date, container type, quantity, destination, and tracking reference. Supports multi-field sorting with visual indicators.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout component with responsive navigation header, mobile menu toggle, and authentication-aware routing for production tracking pages (dashboard, production entry, history, dispatch, work-in-hand, daily reports).
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Authentication button component that handles Internet Identity login/logout with loading states and query cache clearing on logout.
frontend/src/components/ProductionHistor: Sortable table component displaying production records with client-side sorting by date, container type, quantity, or shift in ascending/descending order.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog for first-time user profile setup that prompts for name entry and prevents dismissal until completed.
frontend/src/components/RecentProduction: Table component displaying the most recent production records with a configurable limit (default 10).
frontend/src/components/SummaryCard.tsx: Reusable card component for displaying summary statistics with an icon, title, value, and optional description.
Table component showing current inventory status by container type with produced, dispatched, and current inventory quantities.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance with Internet Identity authentication, initializes access control, and invalidates dependent queries on identity changes.
Mutation hook for adding dispatch records that invalidates dispatch and work-in-hand queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useAddProductionRecor: Mutation hook for adding production records that invalidates production and work-in-hand queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateDailyProduct: Mutation hook for creating daily production reports that invalidates the reports query on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteDailyProduct: Mutation hook for deleting daily production reports by finding the report ID from date and operation name, then invalidating the reports query.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllDailyProduct: Query hook that fetches all daily production reports from the backend actor when authenticated.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllDispatchReco: Query hook that fetches all dispatch records from the backend actor when authenticated.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllProductionRe: Query hook that fetches all production records from the backend actor when authenticated.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetCallerUserProfi: Query hook that fetches the current authenticated user's profile with combined loading state from both actor initialization and profile fetch.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetProductionRecor: React Query hook that fetches production records filtered by date range, falling back to all records if dates are not provided.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetWorkInHandStatu: React Query hook that fetches work-in-hand status records from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context and hooks for ICP login/logout, managing identity state and delegation validation.
frontend/src/hooks/useIsCallerAdmin.ts: React Query hook that checks if the current caller has admin privileges.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralized collection of React Query hooks for user profiles, production records, dispatch records, and work-in-hand status with mutations and cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useSaveCallerUserProf: React Query mutation hook for saving the current user's profile and invalidating the profile cache.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateDailyProduct: React Query mutation hook that updates an existing daily production report by finding it by date and operation name.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom industrial-themed color palette for light/dark modes, including steel blue primary colors and utility classes for tables and cards.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/DailyProductionReport: Page component for managing daily production reports with form entry, filtering, table display, and inline editing capabilities.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Dashboard page displaying production metrics (total produced, dispatched, work-in-hand) via summary cards and a recent production table.
Page component for recording and viewing dispatch records with a form and sortable table of dispatches.
frontend/src/pages/ProductionEntryPage.t: Form page for entering daily production records with fields for date, container type, quantity, shift, and notes. Validates input and uses useAddProductionRecord hook to submit data with toast notifications.
frontend/src/pages/ProductionHistoryPage: Displays historical production records with date range filtering using DateRangeFilter component and ProductionHistoryTable. Shows loading state while fetching data via useGetProductionRecordsByDateRange hook.
frontend/src/pages/WorkInHandPage.tsx: Dashboard showing current inventory status by container type with summary cards for total inventory, container types, production, and dispatches. Displays data in WorkInHandTable using useGetWorkInHandStatus hook.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support. Includes functions to get, store, clear, and persist parameters across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom theme extending colors using OKLCH color space, container settings, border radius variables, custom animations for accordions, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata defining a mobile-first industrial production tracking application for 40ft High Cube Container manufacturing with admin authentication, daily production entry, dashboard, history, dispatch tracking, and operation-wise status features.
